collection.title: Abarth 695C 2012 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Abarth 695C (2012 Onwards) requires windscreen wiper blades to ensure clear visibility in all weather conditions. The driver's side blade should be 24" in length, while the passenger's side blade should be 14". These windscreen wiper blades are specifically designed to fit the Abarth 695C (2012 Onwards) model, which features a Push Button type arm attachment for easy installation. Trust our high-quality windscreen wiper blades to maintain excellent visibility and keep you safe on the road.
